metadata.title: Ruling out Infinite-Time Bubbling under $SO(4)$-Equivariant Yang--Mills Flow on $\mathbb{S}^4\times SU(2)$
metadata.abstract: We study the Yang--Mills flow on $\mathbb{S}^4$ restricted to $\mathrm{SO}(4)$-equivariant connections on the trivial $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ bundle. It was expected that antipodal instanton--anti-instanton configurations would lead to infinite-time singularities along the flow. We show that this does not occur. Moreover, for any smooth equivariant initial condition, the flow converges to the trivial flat connection.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 在 S⁴ 上 SO(4) 等变联络的 Yang–Mills 流中排除预期的无穷时气泡，并证明光滑等变初值收敛至平坦联络。
analysis.breakthrough: 为该对称类别的长期动力学给出全局收敛结论。
analysis.limitations: 结论限定 SO(4) 等变及平凡 SU(2) 丛。
